The structure of Nd8Hg4As4 (reduced formula Nd2HgAs) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers with 9 neighbors, Hg centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, and Nd centers with 16 neighbors; these neighbor counts and environment assignments come from the supplied CrystalNN geometry-only analysis. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all 16 sites in a single component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between As and Nd polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Nd polyhedra.
